verdict.rationale: A speech-to-text API could plausibly offer in-product AI insights such as summaries, topics, or suggested actions drawn from transcripts, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only transcription features: diarization, word timestamps, audio-type labels, and confidence filtering. The MCP server and x402 API let external AI assistants or agents run transcriptions, which is adjacent functionality and not in-product AI insights or suggestions. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product.
